title: Kissed Pillowy Indian Lamb Biryani
description: A romantic Indian dish featuring tender lamb, fluffy basmati rice, and sweet Turkish delight, all combined in a pillowy and slightly bitter biryani, carefully prepared to be onion and garlic free.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat the ghee over medium heat and add the cumin seeds.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the coriander powder, salt, and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the yogurt, rose water, and lemon juice, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let it cook for 10 minutes.
In a separate pot, bring 4 cups of water to a boil and add the basmati rice.
Cook the rice until it is 70% done, then drain the water.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, lamb mixture, and diced Turkish delight.
Mix well and transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
